analysis.session_summary: The overnight tape was dominated by the FOMC press conference at 19:30, where USD fell 0.242% even though the Fed held rates at 4.00%. CAD and JPY led the majors, while NZD was the weakest. Asia then produced largely uncaused, mean-reverting chop as most post-00:30 legs had no clear catalyst.

themes.evidence: USD fell 0.242% during the press conference; the first USD/JPY leg closed -56.4 pips with high confidence, and most FOMC legs had high confidence.
CAD closed +0.239% as rank 1, JPY +0.156% as rank 2, while NZD fell -0.174% as rank 8.
After 00:30 multiple legs had confidence none and nearest events were too weak to own the move.

currency_drivers.USD: FOMC press conference weakened it 0.242% despite an as-expected 4.00% rate decision.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own releases; held its range with a -0.102% net move and 1.52 sigma sensitivity to FOMC.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own releases; closed at +0.156% as VIX rose 1.328 points, implying safe-haven demand.
currency_drivers.GBP: No own releases; held its range with a -0.011% net move.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; FOMC-led pop faded, leaving +0.038% after an attempt rejected.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases or identified catalyst; led majors, closing at +0.239% rank 1.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own releases; held its range with a -0.042% net move.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; weakest major at -0.174% after fading from its FOMC pop.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: The pair's only catalyst-driven move was the first leg up (+23.0 pips on FOMC); subsequent up and down legs had no clear catalyst and left a net -0.5 pips.

polarity_reads.read: USD fell 0.242% during the press conference but polarity is unscored; the reaction implies the market used it to sell USD, not to respond to a data surprise.
Actual met forecast at 4.00% with no quotes around the release; polarity no-data, so the rate decision itself gave no independent USD signal.

scenarios.name: Strong US data revives USD
scenarios.thesis: Advance GDP and Core PCE beat forecasts, reversing the overnight USD weakness.
triggers: US Advance GDP q/q above 3.2% forecast
scenarios.invalidation: US data misses and USD/JPY holds below the overnight close.

pair_paths.rationale: The overnight EUR/USD range was 46.5 pips; a USD bid can push it back toward the low end of that range.
USD/JPY overnight range was 74.1 pips; higher US yields on a GDP beat lift the pair.

scenarios.name: USD weakness extends after dovish FOMC follow-through
scenarios.thesis: Soft US data and continued FOMC-driven dollar selling keep USD under pressure, with EUR/USD and AUD/USD pressing higher.
triggers: US Advance GDP q/q below 3.2% forecast
scenarios.invalidation: ECB explicitly signals more cuts than expected or US data far exceeds forecast.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD range is 46.5 pips; if USD remains weak, the pair retests the overnight high.
USD/JPY range was 74.1 pips; continued downside fits the first FOMC leg of -56.4 pips.

scenarios.name: ECB dovish surprise caps EUR and produces range
scenarios.thesis: ECB keeps rates at 2.65% but the press conference emphasizes downside risks, limiting EUR upside even as USD is soft.
triggers: ECB Main Refinancing Rate at 2.65% as forecast
ECB Press Conference emphasizes dovish tone
scenarios.invalidation: ECB signals a hawkish shift or USD data is strongly negative.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD range was 46.5 pips; dovish ECB neutralizes USD weakness and holds the pair in its overnight band.
EUR/GBP overnight range was 10.5 pips; ECB tone and GBP stability keep it compact.

risks.why_it_matters: VIX rose 1.328 points and Brent whipsawed; risk-sensitive currencies already showed uncaused chop.
USD fell 0.242% on FOMC, showing crowded positioning; a strong GDP or Core PCE beat can force a sharp reversal.
EUR is the second-weakest major at -0.102% and has a 1.52 sigma sensitivity to FOMC headlines; a dovish ECB can extend EUR underperformance.
risks.watch: 14:15 ECB refi rate and 14:45 press conference.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: US Advance GDP, Core PCE, claims and the ECB decision/press conference can reprice both USD and EUR after an overnight tape driven mainly by FOMC communication.
